investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Unschedulable: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 3 Remote-Agent Checks
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api at 2026-06-28T04:51–04:59Z with an identical Kubernetes scheduling error: the 6-node cluster had only 2 nodes carrying the kata.peerpods.io/vm resource, both of which were already at capacity, while the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector. Because the agent pod could never be scheduled, the runner never received a VM ID or a remote state value, so all four required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) were absent and the expected-output contract was fully unmet.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agent swarm has exhausted its allocatable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the 2 eligible nodes. Every new remote-agent pod is immediately placed in Unschedulable state because 0/6 nodes can satisfy the request: 2 nodes have Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm and 4 nodes do not match the pod's node affinity/selector. Preemption cannot help because no lower-priority victims exist on the 2 eligible nodes. The pod never starts, so the eval runner never reaches the point where it can write orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, or remoteState into the evidence object, causing a complete contract gap and a fail status on all three sibling checks.

Because the agent pod could never be scheduled, the runner never received a VM ID or a remote state value, so all four required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) were absent and the expected-output contract was fully unmet.
investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agent swarm has exhausted its allocatable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the 2 eligible nodes. Every new remote-agent pod is immediately placed in Unschedulable state because 0/6 nodes can satisfy the request: 2 nodes have Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm and 4 nodes do not match the pod's node affinity/selector. Preemption cannot help because no lower-priority victims exist on the 2 eligible nodes. The pod never starts, so the eval runner never reaches the point where it can write orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, or remoteState into the evidence object, causing a complete contract gap and a fail status on all three sibling checks.
